common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production world-pickup sprite for UNDERCROFT, a forgotten 1993 first-person dungeon crawler. The input image is the accepted 16px INVENTORY ICON reference board: match the requested item's colour, material and identifying shape so floor object and pack icon are clearly the same possession. Paint ONE isolated object on genuine TRANSPARENT background, NO cast shadow, NO ground/floor patch, no scene, no grid/checkerboard. Three-quarter view looking down at an item resting on flagstones; broad painterly gouache/oil clusters, aged practical materials, chunky clear silhouette. The camera is above the floor, not an overhead map. Pale ivory/ash rim from upper-left lamp light, dark slate occlusion edge but not a thick cartoon outline. Restrained Undercroft slate grey, teal, rusty brown, brass/ochre and ivory. Will be reduced to a 64x48 near sprite and 24px-wide far canvas. Big readable shapes, not intricate linework. No person/hand, no extra objects, no letters or UI.

items.key: ABBEY KEY: a single large old brass skeleton key lying flat diagonally, round ring/bow with a CLEAR OPEN hole, long narrow shaft, one simple toothed bit at lower-right. Match key icon's warm ochre/gold identity and circular bow. Broad worn brass bevel, dark metal recess, a little tarnish, no ornate filigree, no text. Keep ring opening and teeth readable when tiny.
items.clapper: BRASS CLAPPER: a heavy detached bell clapper lying flat diagonally. Match clapper icon EXACT construction: one narrow straight dark/brass stem with a SINGLE big ROUND BRASS BALL at one end, no cup, no bell shell, no handbell, no mallet with two heads. Heavy spherical brass bulb with broad warm gold highlight, stem old tarnished ochre, simple loop/hole at narrow end if readable. Do not make ball a helmet.
items.lamp: HOODED LAMP: a small battered iron lantern standing on a flat stable base, deep hooded brown/slate cap with round top carry-ring, warm ivory-gold rectangular front window recessed under hood. Match lamp icon and the held lamp: four dark edge uprights, simple brown/ochre iron frame, pale warm glass window, broad readable shapes, old utilitarian lamp, no ornate carving. Whole object visible with a stable base. One static lit frame, no flame outside, no glowing halo beyond silhouette.
